report.summary: Both failures come from one cause: app/main.py:150 makes list_books sleep a random 0-8 s on every /books render, and the UI tests use a 5 s Playwright timeout (tests/ui/conftest.py:6-7). The first thing to fix is that artificial sleep, or gate it behind an env flag that is off in CI; until then both tests will fail intermittently, not consistently.

causes.title: Random 0-8 s sleep in list_books exceeds the 5 s UI timeout
causes.explanation: list_books (app/main.py:149-150) calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) before querying. render_books (app/main.py:256) calls list_books, and books_page (app/main.py:314) and books_add's validation-error path (app/main.py:335) both go through it. The UI fixture sets page.set_default_timeout(5000) (tests/ui/conftest.py:5-7). Whenever the random delay is longer than about 5 s, the page load in test_log_out_ends_the_session times out at Page.goto (the page is still about:blank), and the click in test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input times out while waiting for the POST's navigation to finish. Roughly 3 in 8 renders should exceed the limit, so the outcome changes from run to run and the same code can pass on a rerun. The tests are not wrong to wait for the app, and the app is not wrong to be slow in the sense of a deterministic bug; the nondeterministic delay is the problem. The app code is the source of the randomness, so this is not a test_bug and not a product_bug in the usual sense.
evidence: tests\ui\test_login_ui.py:37 in test_log_out_ends_the_session: books = BooksPage(logged_in_page).open() -> tests\support\pages.py:34 self.page.goto("/books") -> Timeout 5000ms exceeded, call log: navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:63944/books", waiting until "load"; page url='about:blank'

tests\ui\test_books_ui.py:42 in test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input: books.add(...) -> tests\support\pages.py:44 click on get_by_test_id("add-book") -> Timeout 5000ms exceeded; the call log reaches 'click action done' then 'waiting for scheduled navigations to finish'
app/main.py:256: "books": list_books(user["id"]) inside render_books, used by books_page (line 314) and books_add's error branch (line 335)
tests/ui/conftest.py:6-7: "Nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s" / page.set_default_timeout(5000)
search_code for random|sleep finds only app/main.py:9, app/main.py:150 and tests/conftest.py:41 (the health-poll sleep), so the random delay exists only in the app
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the random sleep from list_books in app/main.py:150. If the slow path is needed to exercise latency, put it behind an explicit environment variable that the CI test run does not set, and keep it out of the default test server. Once the delay is gone, re-run both tests several times to confirm they pass consistently. Do not just raise the 5 s timeout, because that hides the same nondeterminism and makes the suite slower. Also consider making the test server's latency deterministic if the team wants to test a slow path on purpose.
